host_allowlist.about: no-cloud.py matches a request host against network[] exactly or as a subdomain suffix. Only verified hosts of systems Phase 1 actually uses appear here.

blocked_commands.about: no-cloud.py blocks these outright. The register and the token live on this disk; nothing in Phase 1 needs to push or sync them anywhere.
